chunks: If a man dies and leaves behind a wife and a son, the wife receives one-eighth, and whatever remains goes to the son. Likewise, if he leaves behind a wife and a daughter, the wife receives one-eighth, and whatever remains goes to the daughter. If he leaves behind a wife, a son, and a daughter, or sons and daughters, then the wife receives one-eighth, and whatever remains goes to the sons and daughters, with the male receiving the share of two females.

key_terms.لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ: the male receives the share of two females
key_terms.وَمَا بَقِيَ: the remainder of the estate after the fixed share

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided between a wife and children when a man dies?
ai.summary: This hadith states the inheritance ruling for a wife when the deceased leaves offspring. The wife receives one-eighth of the estate, and the remainder is distributed among the children, with sons receiving twice the share of daughters.
